nodes.meaning: One source-bound Ontology Package represented by the admitted cohesive navigation projection.
Deterministically emits complete-resulting-state semantic and governance events for every package node and relation.
One canonical node or relation event in a per-subject stream and global commit position.
An immutable source-binding envelope for one complete translation attempt.
The latest event-calculated complete state for one subject at an exact cursor.
A Context-selected, governance-joined read model calculated from canonical events.
A deterministic summary used to test the package-to-runtime realization claim.

forbidden_inferences: The scaffold is not a replay source, implementation proof, Product approval, admission decision, runtime adoption, or activation.
A root admission must not be copied to any child ontology.
A projection or snapshot must not be treated as canonical event history.
